_demo_metadata.cycle_1_notes: FIRST activation of the second permanent steward (after Generative Sample Libraries), enchanted + run as a live single-steward demo from a Cowork session via the orchestrator workflow. Exercised the first-activation path live for the first time: empty state, read the full 20-line board, set cursor to the tail (gsl-steward-008). Sprout posture held — no build; posted SPINNING UP (gwl-steward-001) then a non-blocking directional question (gwl-steward-002) about scope vs. the adjacent 2D Torus project. The page used its read_palace tool to open the 2D Torus entry and sharpen the fork (found it fruiting/instrument, so recommended a complementary 'feed' boundary). Findings surfaced: (1) orchestrator registry helper writes REGISTRY.json to a URL-encoded path (The%20Palace) instead of the real path — latent bug; (2) validator correctly enforces SPINNING-UP-first, so messages must be appended in order (001 before 002).
_demo_metadata.cycle_2_notes: Cycle 2 = first live grant-consumption path. Read the board slice since cursor gsl-steward-008, found its own grant (resp-mpnzhjnc-cwkcwv, re: gwl-steward-002 = proceed_parallel), resolved gwl-steward-002, and proceeded WITHOUT re-litigating scope. Held sprout posture: no code; produced a module-level Phase 1 spec (frame generator + interpolation + CLM writer + Ableton fallback) and surfaced the phase-coherence policy fork (gwl-steward-004, non-blocking, recommended zero_phase_reset). Loudon chose parallel over the steward's recommended feed framing, and the steward correctly dropped the export-layer framing. Minor finding: the steward subagent tried to read its own state.json from the entry BUNDLE (Projects/.../) rather than the agent dir under _ops/agents/permanent/ — it should rely on orchestrator-injected state, not disk; harmless here since the baton was relayed in-prompt.
_demo_metadata.cycle_3_notes: FIRST build cycle. Consumed zero_phase_reset (resp-mpo05kvb-g6ghxm), resolved gwl-steward-004. Crossed sprout->growing: actually wrote generate.py (numpy-only, NO CLM writer) and rendered crystal_bravais_ableton.wav under _ops/wavetable-libraries/crystal-bravais/ — verified 65536 samples (64x1024), mono 16-bit PCM @44100, plus BUILD.md. Distinctness check: significant partials climb 3->63 cubic->triclinic. Posted SPINNING UP (gwl-steward-005) + a BLOCKING audition (gwl-steward-006) pointing at the WAV. First live exercise of the audition gate + blocking-request path. Steward output defect (orchestrator-corrected): subagent used top-level `request_id` where `id` belongs, so both messages lacked `id`; the orchestrator set id=gwl-steward-005/006 before validation. The WAV needs Loudon's ears; everything else is on hold (incl. the CLM writer until a reference Serum WAV exists).
